svg.text: FIG 01. FULL RA-MedFiLM-BARR Canonical Methodology & Execution Pipeline
Risk-Averse Medical Feature-wise Linear Modulation with Boundary-Aware Residual Refinement | Staged Freeze Architecture (4.84M Parameters)
Feeds 5 FiLM Modulation Sites in G:
PANEL B: FULL RA-MedFiLM-BARR — Proposed Inference Architecture

g.text: TranspConv Up + Cat Skip + ResBlock + FiLM
Single Shared Output Head | 0 Head Swapping
• Bounding Box: (y0, y1, x0, x1) of active pixels
• Global context, proposal area, border entropy, variance
Decision Rule: EXECUTE iff U ≥ τ_C8_final (~ -0.024358)
If U ≥ τ_C8_final → EXECUTE REFINE (proceeds to R_psi)
Dedicated crop resolution; bilinear resize to 256×256
4 Residual Stages + 1 Bridge | Output: 1 Channel Logit
Spatial Fusion: Insert crop into canvas (NO alpha blending)
• Global vs candidate divergence, border shift, area change
Rejection discards harmful crop updates, preventing degradation
• Condition: U < τ_C8_final or no active ROI
• Action: Residual crop verified and accepted
Targeted boundary gain (+1.46 pp bladder stones)
• FiLM init at zero: initial forward is pure identity
• G remains completely FROZEN (no backprop to G)
• Ground Truth: Out-of-fold paired Dice gain: Δ_Dice
→ All 4 modules frozen for Phase 26 Assembly

svg.text: No Joint Training / No End-to-End Backprop
• Each module trained on frozen upstream outputs
• Assembly wrapper introduces exactly 0 new params

g.text: INSET 1: Detailed FiLM Feature-Wise Linear Modulation Mechanism in GlobalMedFiLM
Given task embedding e_t = E(t) ∈ ℝ^32, affine conditioning generators compute scale γ and shift β:
γ(e_t) = tanh(W_γ · e_t + b_γ) ∈ (-1, 1), β(e_t) = tanh(W_β · e_t + b_β) ∈ (-1, 1)
Applied to feature map F ∈ ℝ^(C × H × W) at 5 key decoder/bridge locations:
• Zero-Initialization: W_γ, W_β initialized to 0 → γ = 0, β = 0 at epoch 0 (exact identity mapping F̂ = F).
• Non-Invasive: task_id is never concatenated as an image channel or separate output head.
INSET 2: Regional Residual Refinement & Spatial Canvas Fusion Logic
Cropped patch x_roi concatenated with prior p_roi ∈ ℝ^(4 × 256 × 256) fed into R_psi:
Δl_roi = R_psi( [x_roi, p_roi] ), p_cand_crop = σ( logit(p_roi) + Δl_roi )
Deterministic Recomposition (Spatial Insertion without alpha blending):
p_fused(x, y) = p_cand_crop(x - x0, y - y0) if (x, y) ∈ Window; else p_global(x, y)
• Bounded Correction: The residual refiner only adjusts ambiguous boundary contours, preventing core shifts.
• Fail-Closed Protection: If S_omega detects uncertainty, p_fused is discarded and p_global is restored.

svg.text: Figure 1 Caption (Official IEEE TMI / MedIA Format):

Figure 1. Canonical methodology of FULL RA-MedFiLM-BARR. (A) Heterogeneous multi-domain inputs (dermoscopy, ultrasound, endoscopy, radiography) mapped to discrete task embeddings e_t. (B) Core inference architecture: GlobalMedFiLM (G, 3.52M params) generates initial probability p_global; the Benefit Router (B_phi, 36.8K params) evaluates expected paired gain U = Δ̂ - λ·C, routing candidates or triggering SKIP_GLOBAL; Regional Refiner (R_psi, 1.28M params) predicts residual boundary logit corrections; Post-Safety Gate (S_omega, 1.22K params) evaluates safety probability P(safety), executing ACCEPT or falling back to p_global on REJECT. (C) Staged freeze training strategy: each module is optimized independently without joint gradient backpropagation, ensuring deterministic assembly and zero gradient interference.
